description.zh:
加速模式：
- **whiltelist**: 白名单加速
- **global**: 全局加速
-  **build-in-list**: 系统内置应用加速
description.en:
The acceleration mode:
- **whiltelist**: whitelist acceleration
- **global**: global acceleration
-  **build-in-list**: built-in system application acceleration
The description of the enterprise acceleration policy.
The ID of the enterprise acceleration policy.
The name of the enterprise acceleration policy.

description.zh:
是否开启TLS模式：
- **0**: 不开启
- **1**: 开启
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable TLS mode:
- **0**: disable
- **1**: enable

description.zh:
是否在客户端透出：
- **0**: 不透出
- **1**: 透出
description.en:
Specifies whether to display on the client:
- **0**: do not display
- **1**: display

description.zh: 加速实例的地址（IP或域名）。
description.en: The address (IP or domain name) of the acceleration instance.
The port of the acceleration instance (between 1000 and 60000).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun csas modify-enterprise-accelerate-policy --eap-id eap-ce153a7165c8feea --name '白名单策略001' --description '这是一条内网访问策略' --upstream-type ga --upstream-host 12.34.56.XX --upstream-port 1000 --user-attribute-group '测试用户组' --priority 49 --acceleration-type whitelist --show-in-client 0 --on-tls 0 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun csas ModifyEnterpriseAcceleratePolicy --region cn-hangzhou --OnTls 0 --UserAttributeGroup '测试用户组' --Description '这是一条内网访问策略' --EapId 'eap-ce153a7165c8feea' --AccelerationType whitelist --UpstreamType ga --Priority 49 --ShowInClient 0 --UpstreamHost '12.34.56.XX' --UpstreamPort 1000 --Name '白名单策略001'
